title: Order of operations
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

sections.title: Multiply and divide first
sections.objective: Do multiplication and division before addition and subtraction; otherwise go left to right.
explain: Everyone agrees on this order, so an expression means the same thing to everyone.
× and ÷ are a team: do whichever comes first. + and − are a team too.
sections.key: Multiply and divide first, then add and subtract. Within each pair, go left to right.

worked.note: Then add and subtract, left to right.
Not 15: going left to right from the start (2 + 3 = 5, × 4 …) gives the wrong answer.

sections.workedCaption: Tap through: what gets done first?

sections.title: Parentheses first
sections.objective: Work out what's inside parentheses before anything else.
explain: A minus sign in front of parentheses subtracts the whole result.
sections.key: Parentheses first. Inside them, the usual order still applies.

sections.title: With negative numbers
sections.objective: Use the same order with negative numbers, and the integer sign rules at each step.
explain: Multiply and divide first, then add and subtract, just like before.
Write each step down: signs are easy to lose in your head.
sections.key: Negative numbers don't change the order. At each step, use the integer sign rules.

worked.note: Divide first: a positive ÷ a negative is negative.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.objective: Use the order of operations on any expression.
explain: Now the problems are mixed. Do one step at a time and rewrite what's left.
sections.key: Parentheses → × and ÷ (left to right) → + and − (left to right).

hints.alg.order-ops.no-parens: Find any × or ÷ and do those first, left to right. Then add and subtract, left to right.
hints.alg.order-ops.parens: Work out the parentheses first. Then multiply and divide, then add and subtract.
hints.alg.order-ops.integers: Same order as always. At each step, use the sign rules for integers.
hints.alg.order-ops: Parentheses, then × and ÷ left to right, then + and − left to right.

misconceptionMessages.alg.ops-left-to-right: It looks like you went left to right. Multiply and divide come before adding and subtracting.
misconceptionMessages.alg.ops-add-before-subtract: Adding doesn't come before subtracting: they're a team. Go left to right between them.
misconceptionMessages.alg.ops-multiply-before-divide: Multiplying doesn't come before dividing: they're a team. Go left to right between them.
misconceptionMessages.alg.ops-ignored-parentheses: Work out the parentheses first. They change which step comes first.
misconceptionMessages.alg.ops-int-left-to-right: Negative numbers don't change the order: multiply and divide before adding and subtracting.
misconceptionMessages.alg.ops-int-ignored-parentheses: Work out the parentheses first, then the rest.
misconceptionMessages.alg.ops-int-sign: The order is right, but check the signs at each step with the integer rules.
